@@U02117@@
Kiss me!
Or I'll kiss you!

@@U02118@@
(She embraces him.)

@@U02119@@
Oh—oh, your lips—
they're cold—
cold and silent.
Where has your love gone?
Who's stolen it from me?

@@U02120@@
(She turns from him.)

@@U02122@@
Come! Follow me!
Oh, my love, be brave!
T’ll love you a thousand times over
if only you'll follow me!

@@U02124@@
(Turning to him.)

@@U02125@@
And is it you, then?
And is it really you?

@@U02127@@
It is! But come!

@@U02129@@
You undo the chains,
you hold me again in your arms,
but how is it you aren't afraid of me?
And do you know, my love,
do you really know
who it is you're setting free?

@@U02131@@
Come!
Night's giving way to dawn,

@@U02133@@
I killed my mother,
translation:
@@U02117@@
吻我吧！
不然我就吻你！

@@U02118@@
（她拥抱他。）

@@U02119@@
哦——哦，你的嘴唇——
他们很冷——
寒冷而沉默。
你的爱去哪儿了？
谁从我这里偷走了它？

@@U02120@@
（她转身离开他。）

@@U02122@@
来吧！跟我来！
哦，我的爱人，勇敢点吧！
我会爱你一千遍
要是你能跟着我就好了！

@@U02124@@
（转向他。）

@@U02125@@
那么是你吗？
真的是你吗？

@@U02127@@
是的！但是来吧！

@@U02129@@
你解开锁链，
你再次将我拥入怀中
可你怎么就不怕我呢？
你知道吗，我的爱人，
你真的知道吗
你要释放谁？

@@U02131@@
来吧！
黑夜即将来临，黎明即将到来

@@U02133@@
我杀了我的母亲，
